stages: 从初始场景取可行的五项任务链
Start a feasible five-subtask chain
当前指令和传感器观测送入策略
Condition the policy on the current instruction and sensor observation
被测策略输出机械臂与夹爪动作
Tested policy emits arm and gripper actions
仿真器执行并返回新观测与状态
Simulator executes and returns new observation and state
任务判据决定继续、换指令或结束计分
Task oracle gates retries and instruction changes; timeout ends the chain
feedback: 下一步读新观测；成功才推进指令，超时截断。评测不更新策略。
The next action uses fresh observations. Only success advances the instruction; timeout truncates the chain. No policy updates in evaluation.
test: 1,000 条可行五项链；前缀成功率与平均链长不同，须注明训练/测试场景和传感器。这不是真机验证。
1,000 feasible five-task chains. Prefix success and mean length differ; specify scene split and sensors. This is not a real-robot test.

stages: 腕部图像与机器人状态
Wrist images and robot state
actor 策略输出末端目标
Actor policy outputs a set-point
底层控制器跟踪目标，真机返回新观测
Low-level controller tracks the target; the physical robot returns a new observation
任务奖励与转移写入在线回放
Task reward and transition enter online replay
学习器将回放与示范混采，更新策略及价值网络
Learner mixes replay with demonstrations and updates policy and critic
feedback: 机器人持续向 actor 提供观测，异步学习器周期性回传权重。非想象 rollout；原 SERL 不要求每步人工纠正。
Physical observations close the control loop; the asynchronous learner sends updated weights. No imagined transition or mandatory per-step human correction.
test: 三项 Franka 任务各测 100 次；20 条示范加在线交互对比 100 条示范的 BC，不能据此断言两者真实成本相同。
100 trials per Franka task on three tasks. RL uses 20 demonstrations plus interaction versus BC on 100 demonstrations; these are not matched real-world costs.

representative: Li et al., A Comprehensive Survey on World Models for Embodied AI
stages: 从预测目标与输入条件定位原方法
Identify the primary method, prediction target and conditioning
按决策耦合、时间推理、空间表示分类
Classify decision coupling, temporal reasoning and spatial representation
追问谁选择动作：控制器、策略或无人执行
Identify who selects actions: controller, policy, or no executor
按任务找对照表，回查原实验条件与指标
Select the task-specific table and trace metrics and protocol to the experiment
feedback: 这是读者核证流程，不是模型推理。若原论文无闭环实验，就记录缺口，不画出控制反馈。
This is an evidence-reading workflow, not model inference. If the primary study has no closed-loop test, record that gap instead of inventing feedback.
test: 表 V 的占用 mIoU、表 VI 的 DMC 回报和表 VII 的 RLBench 成功率不可混排；部分回报是从曲线估读。
Table V occupancy mIoU, Table VI DMC returns and Table VII RLBench success cannot form a common ranking; some returns are approximated from curves.
